notes: The 5 separate groups are real, not an error. The booklet builds five independent models and never joins them. Bag 1 makes the red container, the grey container, the pallet with its four canister tanks and the two white canisters. Bag 2 makes the crane truck. The cover shows them as separate play items. I kept them unconnected. Each sits in its own region of the grid (red container y0-5, grey container y8-13, pallet and canisters x12-17, truck y14-25), so no coordinates overlap.
The PIECE LIST has no minifigure parts, so the minifigure (steps 3/4 of bag 1) is not recorded.

Step numbers count every numbered main step and every sub-assembly sub-step in booklet order: red container 1-6, grey container 7-12, canisters 13-14, pallet 15-17, truck 18 onward, ending at step 88. Attach-only steps that add no piece are skipped.

The container bases are built upside-down in the booklet. In the finished model the feet are underneath, so the base rests_on the feet. Feet and base are both given the first step of that model so rests_on only names pieces from the same or an earlier step. The truck chassis underplates p48, p49 and p52 are handled the same way, with step 18.
The round plates on the four pallet domes sit at layer 5, on top of dome bricks that are 3 plates tall in the catalogue.

The four grooved 1x6 tiles (p211-p214) cannot be stacked. They are spread over studded parts: p211 and p212 on the rail plates, p213 on plate p131, p214 on plate p114. The exact spots are approximate because the booklet inset is unclear.

The booklet is low-resolution, so many truck positions are approximate. Where a piece's exact spot was unclear I picked a consistent, supported spot. This applies to the 2x2 inverted slopes, grille tiles, brackets, mudguards and headlight parts.

Position is null for pieces on pins or axles, sideways pieces and hinged pieces: pins, axles, bushes, wheels, tyres, hydraulic tubes, rear beams, rear light plates and their slopes and mudguards, the crane, headlight hinge parts, grilles on bracket faces, radio and wrench. Pieces resting on a null piece still list it in rests_on.
The sticker sheet p193 is a single id used on several parts: globe logo, logo tile and 'Max. 10 T' arm. It is assigned to step 6 and joined to those parts in other_joins.
The bracket (1x2-2x2) is assumed to be 3 plates tall, and its 2x2 face carries two stacked 1x2 grille tiles.
Truck layout runs along x. Front is x=0 (grille, headlights, front axle). Rear is x=15 (red tail, crane pivot, rear axle).
